number.why: The source reports lower-limb amputation HR 1.43 (95% CI 0.80–2.57) for empagliflozin versus placebo, matching the served HR. Analyses included all randomized participants through final follow-up. This confirms an HR, not the RR named in the outcome-level metadata.

quotes.span: All analyses were performed according to the intention-to-treat principle and included data from all randomized participants including information collected between the formal interim analysis and final follow-up visits.
Follow-up was completed on July 05 2022, at which time median follow-up was 2.0 years (interquartile range, 1.5 to 2.4 years).

entry.why: Adult CKD entry eligibility and the randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled SGLT2 intervention are explicit. The served safety endpoint does not undermine population eligibility.

quotes.span: Age ≥18 years or at "full age" as required by local regulation * Evidence of chronic kidney disease at risk of kidney disease progression defined by at least 3 months before and at the time of Screening Visit

This multicenter international randomized parallel group double-blind placebo-controlled clinical trial of EMPAgliflozin once daily to assess cardio-renal outcomes in patients with chronic KIDNEY disease (EMPA-KIDNEY) was designed to assess the effects of SGLT2 inhibition with empagliflozin on kidney disease progression, cardiovascular disease and safety in a wide range of patients with CKD
